title: Simplifying Exponential Formulas with Pi Creatures
full_prompt: Create a Manim scene named SimplifyFormula using the ManimGL/InteractiveScene framework. In this scene, a Randolph Pi Creature is positioned at the bottom edge of the screen. The scene demonstrates the algebraic simplification of an exponential formula step-by-step. First, display the formula e^{c * ln(w)} with specific color mappings (yellow for '{c}' and pink for '{w}'). Write the components of this formula sequentially while Randolph reacts (raising his left hand, pondering, and blinking). Next, show the step-by-step simplification to =(e^{ln(w)})^c, then to =(w)^c, and finally to =w^c using smooth matching Tex transformations. Randolph should change expressions to 'tease' and blink during these steps. After this, transition to a more general case by transforming the initial formula into e^{c * (ln(w) - z_0) + z_0} and the simplified formula into = A w^c. Finally, highlight the simplified term with a teal surrounding rectangle, dim the opacity of the complex formula, and have Randolph look at the result with confused and then speculative ('maybe') expressions.

visual_techniques: Pi Creature animation and expression changes

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing Randolph or PiCreature class definition in standard Manim Community
common_failure_modes.note: Randolph is a custom 3Blue1Brown Pi Creature. In standard ManimCE, this must be mocked or imported from a custom module.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Use of ShowCreation instead of Create in ManimCE
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses ShowCreation, whereas ManimCE uses Create.

common_failure_modes.pattern: InteractiveScene base class missing in standard Manim
common_failure_modes.note: InteractiveScene is specific to ManimGL. Standard ManimCE uses Scene.
